scenes.voice: Page two shows the same item twice. Offset pagination can do that.
Offset says skip a number of rows, then take some. If rows are inserted meanwhile, the pages shift.
Big offsets are also slow, because the database still walks past every skipped row.
A cursor remembers the last item you saw, and asks for what comes after it.
scenes.code:
SELECT * FROM posts
WHERE id > 30
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 10;

scenes.voice: Cursors can't jump to page fifty, so use offset for small, simple lists. Save this for the next time paging breaks.
